passages.text: The Tessiva Ultrasound Probe (model UP-35) is a convex ultrasound probe product made by Lumiden Instruments.
The UP-35 connects to the Lumiden US-800 Ultrasound System and is designed for abdominal imaging.
Note: this Tessiva is an ultrasound probe from Lumiden Instruments, not the Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor from Corvane Medtech.
